scenes.html:
Vela Assist · governed assistant session
The problem with assistants
isn't what they say.
It's what they make up.

One exchange
Answers only from
the context you supply.
POST /api/xrpl/vela-assist-session
{ "message": …, "context": "your product + policy notes" }

A real customer question
"My pool went cloudy two days
after I shocked it.
Do I need to drain it?"

The reply
"Draining the pool is not typically necessary.
Cloudiness after shocking is stirred-up dead algae.
Check pH and alkalinity with 5-way test strips
before adding a clarifier."
Grounded in the context supplied — no invented account facts.

And then the part most assistants skip
It lists what it
could not verify.
claims_to_verify
pH levels after shocking
 
alkalinity after shocking
 
cloudiness duration
A human or a downstream check confirms these before anything reaches a customer.
